integrity: The structural theorem is supported by a complete algebraic and scheme-theoretic argument and a standalone finite-instance checker. Historical novelty is assessed provisionally; no independent scientific assessment is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite posets and ordered commuting-idempotent tuples only; finite enumerations supplement but do not prove the uniform statement. Equivalent older consequences of orthogonal idempotent conjugacy cannot be excluded. The 2026 motivating full text was not obtained.
title: Smooth coloring components and Potts counts of commuting idempotents in incidence algebras
